description: Returns to long Claude Code sessions after the prompt cache has expired, what they cost, and how often people resume sessions explicitly.

links.title: Claude Session Timeline
links.tooltip: One engineer's sessions and prompts on a timeline

options.content:
**How to read this dashboard**

- **Cold return:** a prompt whose first main-thread model request comes more than an hour after the session's previous main-thread request. By then the prompt cache has expired, so the request re-sends the whole conversation and writes it to the cache again.
- **Explicit resume:** the session logged a `--resume`, `--continue` or `/resume` start in the prompt's hour or the hour before. Other cold returns are people coming back to a session left open. The match is by hour, so it is approximate.
- **Sources:** cold returns come from prompts built from Claude Code's log events (`ai_prompts`), so users whose clients send no logs are left out, and log history starts on 2026-10-27. Resume counts come from the hourly session-start metric, which covers every user.
- **Weeks** start on Monday (UTC). Weekly charts show only weeks that have ended and fall fully inside the time range.
- **Filters:** Project, Claude Code OTel teams and User narrow every panel. Repository narrows the cold-return figures only; session starts carry no repository.

panels.description: Prompts in the range whose first main-thread request came after more than an hour of idle time in their session.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cold AS (
  -- A cold return is a prompt whose first main-thread request came more than an hour after the session's previous one; it counts as an explicit resume when the session logged a resume start in the prompt's hour or the hour before.
  SELECT p.started_at, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    p.first_request_context_tokens AS context, p.first_request_cost_usd AS cost,
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_session_starts ss
      WHERE ss.connection_id = p.source_connection_id
        AND ss.session_id = p.session_id
        AND ss.start_type = 'resume'
        AND ss.hour_start BETWEEN TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(p.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00')) - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(p.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00'))
    ) AS resumed
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.idle_before_seconds > 3600
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) AS cost
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
)
SELECT COUNT(cold.started_at) AS "Cold returns",
  COALESCE(SUM(cold.cost), 0) AS "Cold-return cost",
  SUM(cold.cost) / NULLIF(MAX(total.cost), 0) AS "Share of cost"
FROM total
LEFT JOIN cold ON 1 = 1

panels.description: Prompts in the range whose first main-thread request came after more than an hour of idle time in their session.
Cost of cold returns in each completed week, split by whether the session was resumed explicitly (bars, left axis), and the number of cold returns (line, right axis).

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE wk AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < $__timeTo()
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS week FROM wk
  WHERE TIMESTAMP(d) >= $__timeFrom() AND TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) <= DATE_ADD($__timeTo(), INTERVAL 1 SECOND)
),
cold AS (
  -- A cold return is a prompt whose first main-thread request came more than an hour after the session's previous one; it counts as an explicit resume when the session logged a resume start in the prompt's hour or the hour before.
  SELECT p.started_at, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    p.first_request_context_tokens AS context, p.first_request_cost_usd AS cost,
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_session_starts ss
      WHERE ss.connection_id = p.source_connection_id
        AND ss.session_id = p.session_id
        AND ss.start_type = 'resume'
        AND ss.hour_start BETWEEN TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(p.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00')) - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(p.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00'))
    ) AS resumed
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.idle_before_seconds > 3600
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
),
x AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(started_at), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(started_at) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week,
    SUM(CASE WHEN resumed THEN cost ELSE 0 END) AS resumed_cost,
    SUM(CASE WHEN NOT resumed THEN cost ELSE 0 END) AS idle_cost,
    SUM(resumed) AS resumed_n,
    SUM(NOT resumed) AS idle_n
  FROM cold
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT TIMESTAMP(w.week) + INTERVAL 84 HOUR AS "time",
  COALESCE(x.resumed_cost, 0) AS "Cost after an explicit resume",
  COALESCE(x.idle_cost, 0) AS "Cost after idle, no resume",
  COALESCE(x.resumed_n, 0) + COALESCE(x.idle_n, 0) AS "Cold returns",
  COALESCE(x.resumed_n, 0) AS "After an explicit resume",
  COALESCE(x.idle_n, 0) AS "After idle, no resume"
FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN x ON x.week = w.week
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Each engineer's cold returns over the selected range: how many, how many came right after a resume, the context re-sent in tokens (median and p90), the median request cost and the total. Resume rate comes from session starts, which every user sends and which Repository doesn't narrow.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cold AS (
  -- A cold return is a prompt whose first main-thread request came more than an hour after the session's previous one; it counts as an explicit resume when the session logged a resume start in the prompt's hour or the hour before.
  SELECT p.started_at, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    p.first_request_context_tokens AS context, p.first_request_cost_usd AS cost,
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_session_starts ss
      WHERE ss.connection_id = p.source_connection_id
        AND ss.session_id = p.session_id
        AND ss.start_type = 'resume'
        AND ss.hour_start BETWEEN TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(p.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00')) - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(p.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00'))
    ) AS resumed
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.idle_before_seconds > 3600
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user, context, cost, resumed,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user ORDER BY context) AS rn_ctx,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user ORDER BY cost) AS rn_cost,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY user) AS n
  FROM cold
),
per_user AS (
  SELECT user, MAX(n) AS cold_returns,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn_ctx = CEIL(n / 2) THEN context END) AS ctx_p50,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn_ctx = CEIL(n * 0.9) THEN context END) AS ctx_p90,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn_cost = CEIL(n / 2) THEN cost END) AS cost_p50,
    SUM(cost) AS cost_total,
    SUM(resumed) AS after_resume
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY user
),
starts AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(user_email, ''), user_key) AS user,
    SUM(CASE WHEN start_type = 'resume' THEN start_count ELSE 0 END) AS resumes,
    SUM(start_count) AS starts
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_session_starts
  WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_start)
    AND connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(user_email, ''), user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(names.full_name, u.user) AS "Engineer",
  COALESCE(p.cold_returns, 0) AS "Cold returns",
  COALESCE(p.after_resume, 0) AS "After a resume",
  p.ctx_p50 AS "Context, median",
  p.ctx_p90 AS "Context, p90",
  p.cost_p50 AS "Cost, median",
  COALESCE(p.cost_total, 0) AS "Cold-return cost",
  s.resumes / NULLIF(s.starts, 0) AS "Resume rate"
FROM (SELECT user FROM per_user UNION SELECT user FROM starts) u
LEFT JOIN per_user p ON p.user = u.user
LEFT JOIN starts s ON s.user = u.user
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT LOWER(TRIM(a_n.email)) AS email_key,
         COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN a_n.id = a_n.email THEN n_n.name END), MAX(n_n.name)) AS full_name
  FROM accounts a_n
  JOIN (SELECT id, TRIM(REPLACE(full_name, UNHEX('E2808B'), '')) AS name FROM accounts) n_n
    ON n_n.id = a_n.id AND n_n.name LIKE '% %' AND n_n.name NOT LIKE '%@%'
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(a_n.email), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(a_n.email))
) names ON names.email_key = LOWER(TRIM(u.user))
ORDER BY 7 DESC, 2 DESC, 1

panels.description: Share of each Claude Code OTel team's session starts in each completed week that resumed an earlier session. Repository doesn't apply.

targets.rawSql:
-- Completed Monday-start UTC weeks only; every start counts, with or without a session id.
WITH RECURSIVE wk AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < $__timeTo()
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS week FROM wk
  WHERE TIMESTAMP(d) >= $__timeFrom() AND TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) <= DATE_ADD($__timeTo(), INTERVAL 1 SECOND)
),
s AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(hour_start), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(hour_start) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, team_slug,
    SUM(CASE WHEN start_type = 'resume' THEN start_count ELSE 0 END) AS resumes,
    SUM(start_count) AS starts
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_session_starts
  WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_start)
    AND connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(user_email, ''), user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT TIMESTAMP(w.week) + INTERVAL 84 HOUR AS "time",
  s.team_slug AS metric,
  s.resumes / NULLIF(s.starts, 0) AS value
FROM weeks w
JOIN s ON s.week = w.week
ORDER BY 1, 2

-- Repositories the selected users' prompts ran in, labelled as on Token Usage by Repository.
-- 'Unknown' stands for prompts without a repository; a real repository_url is always an
-- https URL, so it cannot clash.
SELECT CASE
    WHEN r.url = 'Unknown' THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?github[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GH: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?gitlab[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GL: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://(www[.])?bitbucket[.]org/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'BB: ')
    -- Bitbucket Server clone URLs carry an scm/ prefix that the SSH remote of the same repository lacks.
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/(scm/)?', 'BB: ')
    ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://', '')
  END AS __text, r.url AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') AS url
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
) r
ORDER BY r.url = 'Unknown', 1;
